author: kevaundray
content: The idea would be to use waggle + seacast for proofs?

author: .just_kk
content:
I want to start by iterating on top of current waggle protocol for payload broadcast. 

TBH I am not yet sure it is feasible to implement full seacast within a week on top of what we currently have in waggle. But we can take some parts of it (e.g. do it without EC in the first iteration if we are not sure about the choice of EC library that we will use across the clients)

+ we need to adapt it a bit for the proofs objects. For payloads we assumed everyone has the committment from the bid. This is not the case for proofs. For proofs objects I think we need every chunk to have merkle authenticated path + one chunk per peer should have the leanXMSS signature of the root.
